_comment: In-progress shows that are abandoned in practice (quiet abandonment, late-run fizzle, rewatch-in-progress — see taste profile). They keep status=watching but are excluded from 'worth continuing' counts in the export. /sync-library warns when one of these shows new watch activity so it can be removed; add a title when a watching show has had no plays for ~6 months and the user confirms it is not coming back.
